_doc: make (CAR-full): generation of apps/car-full/car-full.{csv,map} from apps/shi-2010 and the analysis flow of the paper with the general phase model (rttools/paper/carfull.py, rttools/bench_t/multirate.py). Paths relative to apps/.

source._doc: reference_period_s: the period of SHI2010.csv that maps to scale.period_s (the shortest period of CAR, the period of CAR-V); every period divides by the same ratio

scale._doc: Periods: T / ratio, ratio = reference_period_s / period_s (80). c^(v) = cost_factor round(w(v) T_v / hyperperiod_s) + scheduler_cycles, T_v the task period before the scale, w(v) in cycles per hyperperiod_s on the base_hz basis of shi-2010.txt; payload = floor(bytes / payload_divisor). The run evaluates every pair of cost_factor_candidates x payload_divisor_candidates; cost_factor follows carfull.choose (carv.choose).

mapping._doc: Spiral Mapping of the clusters of CAR on the width x height mesh, the mapping of Figure 4 (rttools.paper.car run_spiral; ORT/GCM on the weights of shi-2010.txt, smallest M2)

platform._doc: clock of the ORCA2 platform (500 MHz, as CAR-V); f0_hz: first frequency of the search; max_utilization: limit of f_CPU / clock for the choice of the cost factor (the utilization of application E, as CAR-V)

memory._doc: Heap model of rttools/ucxgen/memory.py (pe_demand) with in_flight received packets per input edge between PEs. heap_bytes: _heap_size of the car_full image (make car_full, ARCH=riscv/hf-riscv-e, riscv64-unknown-elf-gcc 13.2, build/target/image.map); ram_bytes: RAM of a PE (manycore_top.sv RAM_MSIZE)
